text:
I remember so many

beautiful girls

who have existed


All the beauties

of Troy and those of Achaea


And those of Thebes and

of Propertius's Rome


And many of them

let love pass by,


And died, and for

centuries have not existed


You who are beautiful

now in the streets of

Managua


One day you will be like them

from a distant time,


When the gas stations

are romantic ruins.


Remember the

beauties of the

streets of Troy!


Ah, your pitilessness


More cruel

than Tachito.

translation.title: I Remember So Many
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the sweep from ancient beauties to Managua and the final political sting against Tachito.
